text:
the demo shouldn't be the last step

added a starter page for liquid glass kit: pick a nav, composer or native dialog, copy html/react/vue, or download an html file that runs offline

css material first, your app keeps the behavior

try it:
https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/start/
problem: Demos require extra work before the first integration
change: Three native-control recipes, stack snippets and self-contained HTML downloads
limitation: CSS material only; host application owns real submission, state and dialog triggers. Download includes sample scripts.

evidence.supports: Three semantic recipes, HTML/React/Vue snippets, inline material and host sample behavior
No external runtime resources in downloads; JSX parsing, native form and dialog attributes

publicationGate: Require deployed /start/ readback, mobile layout, controls and download verification before posting
verification: Native composer exact-text guard; own profile after reload and direct permalink text/time readback

text:
a magnifying dock shouldn't move your click target

liquid glass kit scales a visual child while the button stays put

keyboard gets a focus cue, touch keeps stable controls, reduced motion skips the lift

try it:
https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/dock/
problem: Proximity magnification can make targets difficult to acquire
change: Transform a visual child rather than the semantic control
limitation: No navigation or app state management; physical iPhone validation remains open

evidence.supports: Child transforms, stable native controls, focus cue and reduced-motion handling
Public controller behavior and host-owned state

publicationGate: Use a fresh real pointer/focus recording; do not repeat the release announcement

text:
glass has a contrast problem when the background changes

liquid glass kit has an opaque option and preference fallbacks, but you still need to test your actual content

pick a recipe, switch it to solid, then compare both on your backdrop
https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/start/
problem: Transparent fill cannot guarantee readable contrast across arbitrary backdrops
change: Expose the opaque mode alongside a usable recipe
limitation: Preference support varies; no automatic contrast guarantee
nextAction: Compare glass and solid on your own content

evidence.supports: Opaque attributes, reduced transparency, contrast and forced-colors fallbacks
Opaque option in generated recipes and previews

publicationGate: Record actual solid/glass comparison; retain the contrast limitation
